test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Ms. Tina could finish the assignment by Friday - __at a push__, Wednesday.

options.text: try very hard to do something, usually something nice
probably possible, but it will be difficult

solution:
The correct answer is** "probably possible, but it will be difficult".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the meaning of the given idiom with another example:

__
 
• **At a push* (idiom) - ***with*** ***some difficulty, by making a special effort (कुछ कठिनाई से, विशेष प्रयत्न करके)

 
 
• ***Eg.*** *At a push,* we can still make it on time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will some other idioms:

 
• **At a distance *(idiom) *- **From a far way away.

 
 
• ***Eg.*** *At a distance*, it doesn't look like much. But when you get closer, it's quite spectacular.
 
 
 
• **At a set time* (idiom) -**** *At a designated time.
 
 
• ***Eg.*** I'm sure the party starts* at a set time*—where's the invitation?
